✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Device framing with multiple iPhone/iPad/MacBook models and color variants
✅ Customizable generic frames and no-frame option
✅ Configurable canvas aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, etc.)
✅ Optional drop shadows
✅ Background customization (None, Solid, Gradient, Image, Video Blur)
✅ Timeline editing for trimming, speed adjustments (0.25x to 4x)
✅ Cinematic zoom events with customizable timing, scale, and animation
✅ Visible tap feedback (Ripple, Pulse, Ring) with direct placement and customization
✅ Export to .mov with HEVC + alpha support for transparent backgrounds

Maya is a native macOS application designed to enhance iPhone screen recordings by adding professional visual elements. It allows users to wrap recordings in device frames, incorporate cinematic zoom effects, add visible tap feedback, and export polished videos suitable for marketing, social media, or tutorials.

DAVY is a modern Android TV application built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for discovering and watching anime from the current season. It features a TV-friendly interface, a built-in media player powered by ExoPlayer, and pulls data from the Yummy API for a seamless discovery-to-playback experience.

NyetDB is a Rust-based CLI tool designed to provide AI agents with secure, read-only access to various databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis). It acts as a secure gateway, preventing unauthorized write operations and protecting sensitive data through multiple layers of security and logging.
